items.html:
A top-order batsman who is travelling to the World Cup in the Caribbean in 2007 for experience and is unlikely to play a major role. He has previously had problems knowing where his off stump was and has struggled to make an impact in his first few ODIs. He has been described by Andy Moles as a good listener and a hard worker and is aiming to build innings. He spent a lot of time working on the sweep shot at the Winter Training Camp in 2005 and, in 2006, won Bermuda's fielding award. He is a student in Cardiff at UCCE where he is coached by former the Glamorgan player Kevin Lyons.
Alan Curr February 2007
